high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "sannamarin," who posted it 15 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a poster attached to a textured wall with a warm, yellowish light emanating from two frosted glass sconces above it. The poster is titled "Play it Sam" in a stylized cursive font. Below the title, there is a simple illustration depicting a hand holding a cigarette, another hand pouring a drink into a martini glass, a saxophone, and a piano keyboard. Musical notes are scattered around these elements, suggesting a musical theme
